Analyst, Data Engineering & Analytics - Salt Lake City
Goldman Sachs
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah | Division: Engineering | Level: Analyst (2027 new graduate)

About the team:
Our Data Engineering & Analytics team builds the data platforms and reporting that our Asset & Wealth Management business relies on every day. You will partner with engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to turn raw data into reliable insights for clients and risk managers.

What you will do:
- Write and tune SQL queries and Python jobs that move and transform data in Snowflake.
- Build dashboards in Tableau that help stakeholders monitor client activity and data quality.
- Investigate data quality issues, find the root cause, and work with partner teams to fix them.
- Document data definitions and controls so our reporting stays accurate and audit-ready.
- Present findings to senior stakeholders in a clear, concise way.

What we look for:
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field.
- Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python.
- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.
- Interest in financial markets and how data supports business decisions.

Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer.
